## Review checklist

- [ ] The change solves a distinct reader task or maintainer problem.
- [ ] Canonical facts and copy destinations are clear; overlapping authorities are addressed.
- [ ] Related catalog, index and guidance updates are included or explicitly listed as pending.
- [ ] Reported checks reflect observed evidence and disclose remaining limits.
- [ ] New source material has attribution and compatible reuse terms where needed.
